_doc: Saul Sees the Light! voice cast (docs/saul/VOICE.md). narrator / jesus / peter copied unchanged from cast_risen.json (= cast_miracles.json entries plus the timbre pin to Miracles' clips). saul / ananias / barnabas / priest / tallguard / shortguard are new VoiceDesign voices. judas has no lines. Run through tools/story/voice_saul.py (runaway guard, f0 / timbre pins).

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

jesus.design: 男性，三十岁左右，嗓音温暖、清亮、柔和圆润，干净不沙哑，平静从容，亲切又带一点点俏皮的笑意，吐字清楚，像一位温柔的好老师，从不吼叫。普通话标准。
jesus.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
jesus.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

peter.design: 男性，四十多岁，身材高大魁梧的渔夫，低沉浑厚的男低音，胸腔共鸣很重，嗓门大但声音低，豪爽爱笑，热心肠，像一只友好的大熊。就算大喊大叫也是低沉的大嗓门，从不尖细。普通话标准。
peter.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，夸张好笑，但是不吓人，有真实的呼吸。大喊时声音也保持低沉。这一句：
peter.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

saul.design: 男性，二十八岁左右的年轻人，嗓音清亮有力，偏男高音，聪明、干脆、自信，吐字清楚；生气时尖锐急促，温暖时明亮开朗，同一个人。普通话标准。
saul.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
saul.why: young, clear, sharp-or-warm with one voice (CONTRACT §7); pinned above Jesus (120-160) so the two never blur

ananias.design: 男性，六十岁左右的老人，嗓音柔软、温和、略带沙哑和颤抖，有点絮叨，胆子小，心地善良，说话快的时候会拔高，比大个子巴拿巴年老、轻柔。普通话标准。
ananias.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
ananias.why: older, softer and fussier than Barnabas; allowed to squeak in sa_18

barnabas.design: 男性，四十多岁，身材高大的男中低音，宽厚圆润、温暖的大嗓门，像一位亲切的大哥哥，慷慨、鼓励人，说话稳，从不尖细，也不粗哑，不像渔夫那样吼叫。普通话标准。
barnabas.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
barnabas.why: big warm smooth baritone, clearly not Peter (Peter is the booming fisherman bass, 95-135)

priest.design: 男性，七十岁左右的老祭司，嗓音干燥、平稳、缓慢，不冷也不暖，不阴险，平静克制。普通话标准。
priest.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：

tallguard.design: 男性，二十多岁的瘦高个儿，声音又细又高，爱好奇，反应有点慢，滑稽，紧张时压低声音耳语。普通话标准。
tallguard.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
tallguard.why: thin and high, the comic pair's tall half

shortguard.design: 男性，四十岁左右的矮胖子，嗓音圆滚滚、粗声粗气，爱发牢骚、爱吹牛、喘着气，滑稽可笑。普通话标准。
shortguard.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
shortguard.why: round and gruff, the comic pair's short half

narrator.instruct: A warm woman storyteller, like a mother at a child's bedside telling a Bible story to a child of four to ten: friendly, lively, natural, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. This line:
narrator.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

jesus.design: A man of about thirty with a warm, clear, soft and round voice, clean and never hoarse, calm and unhurried, kind with a hint of playful smile, crisp diction, like a gentle teacher who never shouts. Clear standard American English.
jesus.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
jesus.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

peter.design: A man in his forties, a big burly fisherman with a deep, booming bass voice, heavy chest resonance, loud but low, hearty and quick to laugh, warm-hearted like a friendly bear. Even when he shouts his voice stays deep and never turns shrill. Standard American English.
peter.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: comic and big, never scary, with real breaths. Keep the voice deep and low even when shouting. This line:
peter.why: copied unchanged from cast_lastsupper.json (one voice across Miracles, The King Who Serves and He Is Risen)

saul.design: A young man of about twenty-eight with a clear, strong, bright tenor voice: clever, quick and sure of himself, crisp diction; sharp and clipped when angry, warm and open when happy, always the same man. Clear standard American English.
saul.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
saul.why: young, clear, sharp-or-warm with one voice (CONTRACT §7); pinned above Jesus (120-160) so the two never blur

ananias.design: An elderly man of about sixty with a soft, gentle, slightly husky and quavery voice, a little fussy and timid but kind-hearted, voice squeaking higher when he is alarmed; older and lighter than a big baritone. Clear standard American English.
ananias.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
ananias.why: older, softer and fussier than Barnabas; allowed to squeak in sa_18

barnabas.design: A big man in his forties with a full, warm, round baritone, generous and encouraging like a kind older brother, steady, never shrill and never gravelly, not a shouting fisherman. Clear standard American English.
barnabas.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
barnabas.why: big warm smooth baritone, clearly not Peter (Peter is the booming fisherman bass, 95-135)

priest.design: An old priest of about seventy with a dry, level, unhurried voice, neither warm nor cold, never sinister, calm and restrained. Clear standard American English.
priest.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

tallguard.design: A tall, thin young man in his twenties with a thin, high voice, curious and a little slow, comic, dropping to a wide-eyed whisper when nervous. Clear standard American English.
tallguard.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
tallguard.why: thin and high, the comic pair's tall half

shortguard.design: A short, round man of about forty with a round, gruff, puffing voice, always grumbling and boasting, comic. Clear standard American English.
shortguard.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
shortguard.why: round and gruff, the comic pair's short half

sa_01.m_en: storyteller, clear and lively; plain and calm on 抓 / 'arrest' (the only sentence about it), a small frown on 生气 / 'angry'

sa_02.m_en: young, hot-headed, sure of himself; loud but not shouting; a stamp on 都 / 'all'

sa_03.m_en: an old, dry, calm voice; neither kind nor cruel; unhurried

sa_04.m_en: brisk, a marching rhythm in the words

sa_05.m_en: a round, puffing comic voice; out of breath; whiny, funny

sa_07.m_en: wonder, building fast; bright and amazed, never scary; a soft drop on the fall

sa_08.m_en: calm, warm, very clear; sad and loving, not angry; the same Jesus as in Real Miracles

sa_09.m_en: small and shaken, all the anger gone; almost a whisper

sa_10.m_en: gentle and firm; the heart of the scene; slow on 我就是耶稣 / 'I am Jesus'

sa_11.m_en: kind, a fresh start in the voice

sa_15.m_en: gentle, unhurried; no sadness on 不吃也不喝 / 'did not eat'

sa_16.m_en: a quiet, honest prayer; humble, eyes closed; no tears

sa_18.m_en: the comic beat: an older, fussy voice squeaking in alarm, words tumbling out; frightened in a funny way

sa_19.m_en: patient, warm, a smile in it; no scolding

sa_20.m_en: a big gulp, then brave; a little laugh at himself at the end

sa_22.m_en: gentle and brave; a warm weight on 弟兄 / 'Brother'

sa_24.m_en: joy bursting out; then quiet, moved, amazed at 弟兄 / 'brother'

sa_25.m_en: warm, glad, a happy chuckle inside the words

sa_27.m_en: mouth half full, laughing, a big grin; the old anger quite gone

sa_28.m_en: glad, warm, strong; the same voice as the angry Saul, now full of joy

sa_31.m_en: a little hush, mock-suspense; not scary

sa_32.m_en: puffed-up, boastful, comic; a yawn creeping into the end

sa_34.m_en: from up in the window, a loud whisper, fussy and kind

sa_35.m_en: a happy whisper up to the window

sa_36.m_en: gentle, a small worry in it

sa_37.m_en: big Peter, small voice; worried, comic

sa_38.m_en: big, warm, encouraging; a friend's arm in the voice

sa_39.m_en: a slow smile, then a big glad welcome

sa_40.m_en: joyful and sure; a happy surprise on 保罗 / 'Paul'

sa_41.m_en: straight to the child, warm, amazed and glad

sa_42.m_en: warm, slow, a hush on the last words
